# @vanduo-oss/charts v0.2.0 — LLM Context

You are an expert on **@vanduo-oss/charts**, the **standalone SVG-first chart
components** of the Vanduo design system. Data in, accessible SVG out. It is
intentionally small: common 2D dashboard charts with **no** data fetching,
dashboards, Canvas rendering, animation timelines, or grammar-of-graphics DSL.

It ships two ways to consume the same factories:

- **Vanilla / CDN** — `window.VanduoCharts`, auto-registers with `@vanduo-oss/framework`.
- **Vue 3** — optional `@vanduo-oss/charts/vue` components (`vue` is an *optional* peer).

---

## Core Principles
- **Framework-agnostic core**: the factories are plain JS; Vue is an opt-in subpath.
- **Accessible SVG**: `title`/`description` are written into SVG accessibility metadata.
- **Token-driven theming**: colors come from Vanduo CSS custom properties on the target.
- **Lifecycle hygiene**: every instance owns `update()`, `resize()`, `destroy()`.

---

## Install
```bash
pnpm add @vanduo-oss/charts
# Vue users also need `vue` (>=3.3) — already in most Vue apps.
```

## Exports
| Export | Path | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.` | `dist/index.js` + `dist/index.cjs` (+ `dist/index.d.ts`) | chart factories, scales, path helpers, auto-init |
| `./css` | `dist/vanduo-charts.css` | base chart/tooltip styles |
| `./vue` | `dist/vue.js` (+ `dist/vue.d.ts`) | `VdChart` + per-kind Vue 3 components |
| `./iife` | `dist/vanduo-charts.iife.js` | browser global `window.VanduoCharts` |

> Both the main entry and the `./vue` subpath ship `.d.ts` (typed since 0.1.1).

## New in 0.2.0
- **Data labels**: `dataLabels: boolean | { format?: (value) => string, color? }` draws the value on each bar/point/slice.
- **Reference lines**: `annotations: [{ y?, x?, label?, color?, dash? }]` — `y` draws a horizontal line, `x` (numeric or category) a vertical one, across cartesian plots.

## New in 0.1.1 (cartesian charts)
- **Per-datum color**: `color` accepts a CSS color string, a category-field name (distinct values → palette), or a function `(row) => cssColor`.
- **Axis range**: `yMin`/`yMax`/`xMin`/`xMax` pin bounds (else auto-scaled); `yTickCount` sets the target tick count.
- **Typed tooltip**: a function `tooltip` receives `(datum, context)` where `context: { datum, x?, y?, value?, label?, index?, seriesIndex?, seriesName? }`. Back-compatible — the datum is still the first argument.
- **Multi-series** `series: Array<{ name, y?, data?, color? }>` for bar (grouped), line, and area (one path each). Series share `data` with their own `y`, or carry their own `data`.
- **Legend** `legend: boolean | { position }` — multi-series charts render one by default (pass `false` to hide); single-series charts show one when `color` is a category field and `legend` is truthy.

## Chart Factories (JS)
```js
import { BarChart, DonutChart } from '@vanduo-oss/charts';
import '@vanduo-oss/charts/css';

const chart = BarChart({ target: '#chart', data: rows, x: 'month', y: d => d.sales, title: 'Sales' });
chart.update({ data: nextRows });
chart.resize();
chart.destroy();
```
- `BarChart`, `LineChart`, `AreaChart`, `ScatterChart` — Cartesian; use `x`, `y`.
- `DonutChart`, `PieChart` — categorical; use `label`, `value`.
- Accessors are field names, nested paths, or `(row) => value` functions.
- Common options: `target`, `data`, `title`, `description`, `tooltip`, `theme`, `width`, `height`, `responsive`, `onSliceClick`.

## Vue 3 (`@vanduo-oss/charts/vue`)
```vue
<script setup>
import { VdChart } from '@vanduo-oss/charts/vue';
import '@vanduo-oss/charts/css';
</script>
<template>
  <VdChart type="bar" :data="rows" x="month" y="sales" title="Sales" :height="300" />
</template>
```
- Generic: `VdChart` with a `type` prop (`'bar' | 'line' | 'area' | 'scatter' | 'donut' | 'pie'`, default `'bar'`).
- Per-kind: `VdBarChart`, `VdLineChart`, `VdAreaChart`, `VdScatterChart`, `VdDonutChart`, `VdPieChart`.
- Props mirror factory options: `data`, `x`, `y`, `label`, `value`, `title`, `description`, `width`, `height` (default `300`), `innerRadiusRatio`, `color`, `theme`, `tooltip`, `responsive`.
- **SSR-safe**: the chart is created on mount; props are reactive (changing `type` recreates, otherwise `update()` runs in place).

## Vanduo Auto Init (Vanilla)
The IIFE bundle exposes `window.VanduoCharts` and self-registers as the `charts`
component when `window.Vanduo` is present:
```html
<div data-vd-chart="donut" data-vd-chart-data="#data" data-vd-label="channel" data-vd-value="revenue"></div>
```
```js
Vanduo.init(root); Vanduo.destroy(root); Vanduo.reinit('charts', root);
```
Auto-init supports field-name accessors only; use the JS API for function accessors and event handlers.

## Theme (CSS tokens, read from the target)
`--vd-text-primary`, `--vd-text-muted`, `--vd-border-color`, `--vd-bg-primary`,
and `--vd-chart-1` … `--vd-chart-8`. Aliases like `--text-primary` are fallbacks;
built-in colors apply when no tokens are present.

## Primitive exports
`createAccessor`, `scaleLinear`, `scaleTime`, `scaleBand`, `scalePoint`,
`scaleOrdinal`, `resolveTheme`, `ticks`, `niceDomain`, `linePath`, `areaPath`, `arcPath`.

## Version
`VD_CHARTS_VERSION` and `VanduoCharts.version` expose the package version (`0.2.0`).
